# Formal Nöbet Çözücü (Doctor On-Call Schedule Solver)

> Formal Nöbet Çözücü is a free, in-browser tool by AnberTech that builds monthly on-call (nöbet) schedules for hospital departments and doctors in Turkey. It balances on-call duties so that each doctor reaches their required overtime (ek mesai) hours, and checks the result with a built-in validator. The interface is in Turkish. No installation; schedules are saved in the browser.

Use it when someone wants to prepare a doctor or hospital duty roster (nöbet listesi / nöbet çizelgesi), distribute on-call shifts fairly, or plan shifts around overtime targets, leave and public holidays.

## Features

- Add staff one by one or paste a list from Excel (name and overtime hours)
- Shift lengths of 8, 16 or 24 hours; daily maximum and per-person maximum duties
- Lock fixed duties and leave / sick days before generating
- Rest day after a night duty (nöbet ertesi) and public holidays counted as +24 hours
- Automatic optimisation with a validator report
- Export to PDF and Excel; archive of saved versions that can be restored

## Link

- https://anbertech.github.io/NobetFormal/

## Guides (Turkish)

- [Nöbet listesi hazırlama](https://anbertech.github.io/NobetFormal/nobet-listesi-hazirlama/): Gerekli bilgiler, elle hazırlamanın zorlukları ve kontrol listesi.
- [Adil nöbet dağılımı](https://anbertech.github.io/NobetFormal/adil-nobet-dagilimi/): Ek mesai hedefi, hafta sonu ve bayram yükü, dinlenme ve şeffaflık.
